The purchase_insurance function expects insurance_cost as float. It likely expects cost in USD? The description: "The cost of the insurance This is a float type value." It doesn't specify currency. But earlier we used compute_exchange_rate to convert USD to EUR. For insurance, we can provide cost in USD. But user says "insurance amount approx 150 euros". So we need to convert 150 EUR to USD. Let's compute exchange rate: base USD to EUR gave 1200->960. So 1 USD = 0.8 EUR. So 150 EUR = 187.5 USD. But we don't know exact rate.
